overview_description.description:
Clockwise is the solution to the modern workday. It’s a time orchestration platform that brings much needed flexibility to our schedules, using AI to better balance heads down time and time spent working together.

Think of it as a new way of working — protecting the time we need most and preventing burnout. Entire team schedules come together in harmony.

Personal time is dedicated to focus each day. And we’re present in every meeting knowing that our schedules respect the time we need to ourselves. With Clockwise, our workdays finally start to work for us.

about_short_description.short_description: Clockwise develops an AI-powered scheduling platform that automates meeting, calendar management, and scheduling across workplace.

product.name: Clockwise AI Scheduling Assistant
product.description: An AI-driven calendar assistant that optimizes scheduling by rearranging events and finding meeting times across multiple calendars based on user preferences.

product.name: Deep Work Seeker
product.description: A feature that creates and protects blocks of uninterrupted time on calendars to support focused work and reduce interruptions.

product.name: Busy Calendar Bee
product.description: A scheduling automation tool that manages meetings for busy teams by adjusting calendars according to shifting priorities and individual work preferences.

product.name: Networking Navigator
product.description: A tool that facilitates scheduling meetings with external contacts by minimizing conflicts and finding the best times for all participants.

product.name: Flexible Holds for To-Do Management
product.description: A feature that converts to-do lists into flexible calendar holds that automatically adjust as schedules change.
